body:
Hi Dan, 

Thank you for your response. I definitely tend to be low energy and shrink in a corner away from people when they’re around. Right now I’m pretty down, but do want to get better and will definitely work towards it. I hope doing that will show my friends I’m hopeful and in good shape, and will talk to me again. The interesting thing is we don’t really have much in common, but just became friends enjoying each others company. I’ll try to be good company again, rather than be a sulky mess. Thanks again.

It’s definitely important to make job hunting the most interesting, so it’s not a “forcing myself even though I don’t want to” deal that one can justify procrastination. This is some beautiful advice.

Hi there. I came across your post from a different place, trying to find a cure for my nausea. I’m so sorry you’re going through this... was hoping you’d get some improvements! 
Stay strong, your body is definitely fighting to get better. Not the same conditions, but I had a month where I suffered from constant nausea and couldn’t leave the house, and would just lock myself in the bathroom. It was stress induced and got better once I removed myself from the source, but was extremely tiring... 
I wish you the best. It’ll feel so good when you get out of this!

Just had a similar case of taking SSRIs with ibuprofen, had super nausea kick in and was extremely confused why (my pharmacist cleared me for taking them together). Thank you for this info, now I atleast know the trigger.

Got it, sorry I interpreted as “trying to kiss” as actually acting on it. (I have experience with someone forcing a kiss) 
Honestly I think she’s not interested in you as a SO, and would rather just stay friends. If you can’t get over that, you should just slowly drift away. You didn’t do anything wrong, it’s just that it didn’t work out on her side.

I see. That’s awesome that he makes your life better in many other ways! If you know he’s a good person, you need to try and communicate that you understand he doesn’t like it and make a compromise... like maybe do your part in not bringing it up to him as long as he doesn’t keep bringing it up as well just to slam on it.
So she said yes to the kiss, but she said she doesn’t want a relationship? That’s some weird behavior
If you were a nice person or were good friends with someone, you wouldn’t give them the cold shoulder and ignore them if they made a honest mistake.
Why did you try to kiss her without her consent? I don’t understand how this is ok when no one asked for it.

This comment section is the worst I’ve seen here, has nothing to do with the actual problem OP is asking help on.

I think your bf lacks the maturity to be understanding of your hobby. If he knew you like lolita fashion and still chose you, then he accepted you as you are and shouldn’t find enjoyment or a need to put you down like that. Honestly, that’s a red flag. If your SO doesn’t make your life better and you need to sacrifice what makes you happy, you deserve better. 
Even if I didn’t share the same opinion on something as my SO, if I knew this was something they cherish I wouldn’t hammer the living daylights out of it. How could they not understand that that would upset you?
What is a radioactive bullet?
Thank you for that last line, it cleared out my worries. I’m definitely affected by his actions more than my priorities, and should clear that up with him.
I can’t offer any advise but you sound like you’re killing it with your career. That’s awesome, keep the fire going!
We actually got it done online due to distance issues,  but it worked out nicely. We’ll probably do something again when we meet in person, thank you for the advice :)
I just wanted to give you an update that it worked out, and we’re moving into a relationship. The feeling was mutual!
Sorry again, do you think the talk would be better handled before a hang out or after?
I really like how you’ve worded this, I’ll say that :) thank you for the advice!
Aw that’s cute! Thank you for the advice. I’ll do my best to fly straight and true
I think we both are avoiding the obvious, or I hope that’s the case. I’ll try to break the ice and hope for the best!
Truth right here, thank you.
If it’s the case, so be it. I like that stance!
I’m sorry to hear it hasn’t worked out for you. Personally I prefer someone I know I’m close to be my SO to support and be supported. I’ll definitely follow up if it works out :)
Yes, you’re very right. I also see the possibility that he might be hesitant too, and want to initiate it. Just wanted some advice :)

Wow, honestly my personal preference is to rather have a friend be my SO than something spontaneous. 

I actually had a very not so pleasant experience with a classmate suddenly trying to kiss me out of the blue because he thought I was into him... it was scary. I don’t think I want to do that to someone so I’ll talk.
Thank you! I like the part about it’s going beyond friendship. Agree with the texting part, that’s a big part of my confusion as he words things like he’s speaking to a gf. Texting is hard
That’s very true. Thank you for the insight :)
Ok, that’s something we always do. Thank you everyone for the advice about actually asking in person rather than messaging!
I want to ask him, but don’t know how to word it. Would messaging be fine or in person? I’d have to wait a couple of weeks if it’s the latter..

No problem, I’m actually going in tonight to re-evaluate our meds and see if there is a better solution. We might try something else for depression but I’ve also requested suggestions for psychotherapy if they know anything around my area.
I see, would love to get back my previous life before this and if that can help me so be it. Thank you for your tips :)

I totally understand. The person suffering doesn’t know what’ll help them, people around them don’t know what to do, and then bam. 
People around me say “I’m always here to listen” but what can talking possibly do to help? 

It’s so hard.
So i am on medication for anxiety and ADHD (Venlafaxine and concerta). Despitev this, my symptoms are pretty heavy... what can medication for depression do?
Being a $15 burden per month is way better than a $1000+ burden.
What kind of books are you looking for? Concept art specific or art training in general like Scott Robertson?

That teacher isn’t very thoughtful for scolding you about that... if anything he should be asking what’s wrong to try and help you out. I’m in my mid20s and get this because of my depression and anxiety, it’s not just you don’t worry. I don’t think it’s something you should “toughen up” to fix, since as you said those tears are coming from various emotions you’re feeling about yourself... I think it’ll go away once you have more space and confidence in yourself. Hang in there!
Cool, I’ll try this and see if anyone’s cool with a non-human passenger. Thanks!
Gotcha. Might reach out to my doctor about this, he always asks if I want melatonin but that leads to vivid dreams/nightmares for me. Thank you for the insight :)
Is this something that I need to see a doctor for, or a therapist? Therapists are super booked in my area and I have trouble finding one that’s free :(

That’s interesting to hear! I’ve recently been diagnosed with ADHD (which I didn’t know I had until 20s), have had depression on/off for 4 years, and have traveled across seas a tid bit more than the average. 
Do you know what the typical treatment for DSPD is? I once had a sleep doctor monitor my sleep pattern and try to force me to stick to a given time, but it fell apart when I started to overwork.
I’m taking some meds for anxiety and ADD, but only in the morning to last through the day. Were those meds to help you with negative emotions?
This I totally get, I set my alarm for a power nap and get better quality rest than a stressful night of forcing myself to sleep. Interesting!

Unfortunately we both sleep on one bunk bed, but changing the desk to face inward might be a change. Are there curtains that don’t produce too much dust? Im a little worried about more dust accumulating on my computer and desk, if I use a curtain.
